title: refactor(metadata-protocol): the publishPackageDrafts body moves into its facet, protocol-history-and-publish.ts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi91A9PCgBSi18jLsTur5vARs)_
> **⏸ This PR waits for a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approval (`os-zhuang` or `hotlong`) before it lands.** It touches a Tier H path (`docs/adr/0005-metadata-customization-overlay.md`, one symbol anchor re-pointed because the code it resolved to moved). It is 2,154 changed lines, under the 3,000-line rule, and otherwise a mechanical move generated by the codemod and proven byte-for-byte reversible. The seat will not mark it ready or queue it before that approval.

Refs #30020
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

#30020 §5 item P1, `publishPackageDrafts`, the last item of the approved order. The card stays open: two other `#30020` rows remain in `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` (`protocol.ts` `applySeedBodies` and `sql-driver.ts` `constructor`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：给协议拆分脚本 `scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs` 补上引擎脚本已有的 R1（方法体里把实例自身交出去的裸 `this` 改读宿主上的 `facade` 端口），再用它把 `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation#publishPackageDrafts` 的 914 行方法体原样搬进 `protocol-history-and-publish.ts` 的 facet；类上保留签名和文档注释的一行转调桩，门禁登记表删掉这一行例外。
- 为什么改：#30020 的 §5 顺序里 P1 是最后一项；它一直搬不动，是因为方法体里有一处 `(this as any).getMetaItem(...)` 把实例本身交出去，协议脚本此前没有对应改写。
- 风险与回滚：纯机械搬移，语句与顺序不变，唯一的改写是那一处 `this` → `this.facade`（宿主工厂把它填成实例本身）；`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 发布的 `.d.ts` / `.d.cts` 与基线逐字节相同，撤销证明逐字节重建基线。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：① `protocol-host.ts` 新增的 `facade` 条目和 `protocol.ts` 工厂里的 `facade: protocol,`；② 脚本 `receiverReads` / `undoIdentity` 两处；③ `docs/adr/0005-metadata-customization-overlay.md:82` 改指的锚点。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --members --verify --base 6e766012` 应以 0 退出，并打印 "undoing the moves does rebuild the base protocol.ts, protocol-host.ts and section modules byte-for-byte"。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 触及 Tier H 路径（ADR-0005 一处锚点），需要 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

1. **The codemod (`scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs`), R1: the identity port.** The engine codemod's R1 (design ruling A, 6687865760: the facade stays the sole state owner and each host gains a `facade` port), ported to the protocol codemod's `.call(host)` receiver form. Each bare `this` an instance body hands on reads `this.facade`, a `ProtocolHost` entry typed as the class that the host factory fills with the instance itself (`facade: protocol`). The undo proof rewrites every `this.facade` back to a bare `this`, which is unambiguous because a base body that already reads `this.facade` refuses (no declared member) and so does a class that declares `facade`. An indexed `this`, a `typeof this` and a static's bare `this` still refuse. Self-test 112 → 126 cases, 13 → 14 batteries (the new `identity port` battery, floor 14).
2. **The move**, generated by `node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --members publishPackageDrafts --write`: the body (914 lines) moves into `ProtocolHistoryAndPublishFacet` (`protocol-history-and-publish.ts`, the facet of its section). Its one bare `this` (`(this as any).getMetaItem(...)` in the build-probe item reader) reads `(this.facade as any).getMetaItem(...)`. `ProtocolHost` gains `facade` and the four members the body reads that no earlier move had carried (`applyPublishBackfill`, `collectBatchPendingDeclarations`, `planPublishBackfill`, and the statics forwarder's `refuseOrganizationScopedWrite`). `protocol.ts` goes from 12336 to 11426 lines.
3. **`scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json`**: the `publishPackageDrafts` exception row is deleted (the facade gate demands it: a stale row reds with "the member is already a delegation … Delete the row").
4. **Changeset** `.changeset/30020-publish-package-drafts-facet.md`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch (the published JS moves; the `.d.ts` does not).

Forced edits the move needs, each named with the gate that demanded it (seat ruling in the card thread):

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.bracketed-refusal-opener-absence.test.ts`: the by-path `PRODUCERS` table follows the moved throw site, `protocol.ts` 3 → 2 and a new row `protocol-history-and-publish.ts: 4` (the module's `new Error(` count after the move), as #30147 did for its moves. Red without it: "protocol.ts no longer constructs errors here — this pin is scanning the wrong file: expected 2 to be greater than or equal to 3".
- `docs/adr/0005-metadata-customization-overlay.md:82`: the anchor `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts#sys_metadata` resolved only to a `'sys_metadata'` literal inside `publishPackageDrafts`' body. `check:adr-symbol-anchors` red: "`sys_metadata` has no declaration site or string-literal token in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`". It now points at `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts#sys_metadata`, the one-item GET read the sentence describes.

## Tests

The suites ran on `d2ba6b9f`; the head `22a4bb9e` adds only the ADR-0005 anchor line on top of it, and the gates ran on `22a4bb9e`.

- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` full suite on head: Test Files 331 passed | 5 skipped (336); Tests 22655 passed | 29 skipped (22684). The test-file set is the base's; the one extra test is the new `PRODUCERS` row. Includes `package-unmanaged-install.test.ts`, `protocol-publish-drafts-advisories.test.ts`, the publish suites and `protocol.facade-door-return-types.pin.test.ts` (which reads the codemod).
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` typecheck: exit 0.
- Codemod self-test: 126 cases in 14 batteries pass (base: 112 in 13).
- Undo proof: `node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --members --verify --base 6e766012` exit 0.
- Facade gate `pnpm check:facade-delegation-only` (self-test and scan): exit 0, 5 named exceptions.
- Dogfood battery (full, under the lock): Test Files 445 passed | 3 skipped (448); Tests 3690 passed | 42 skipped (3732).

## Acceptance notes

- The receiver form adds no `this` rewrite anywhere else: every other byte of the moved body is the base body's, and both the facet member's text (rebuilt from the base) and the undo are checked.
- No ablation run: the diff changes no runtime behaviour a test pins (a mechanical move), and the codemod's new refusals carry their own mutation cases in its self-test (the `identity port` battery feeds the proof a `this.facade` the rewrite did not write, a rewritten site put back to a bare `this`, and a factory port that hands something other than the instance; each fails the proof).

## Verification

<details><summary>Declaration files (proof bar, ruling 6624345766)</summary>

Head built with a full `pnpm build`; base built by restoring the three moved source files at `6e766012` (unstaged) and rebuilding `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` alone (its dependencies are unchanged between base and head), then restoring head.

- `dist/index.d.ts`: identical, sha256 `b76424e554feb4614593fb33b74c409695d09fb0dab1b53241ab5a9437fdb8f5` on both, 13714 lines.
- `dist/index.d.cts`: identical (`cmp` exit 0).
</details>

<details><summary>Gates on head 22a4bb9e (dispatch-gates)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 96 families against merge base `6e766012` (8 paths, 2154 changed lines). Every one ran and exited 0; `--ran` reconciliation: "96 derived, 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN … a DERIVED zero — all 96 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3". The teardown self-test needed the container prerequisite `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876…` first.
</details>

<details><summary>Lint</summary>

`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` declares no `lint` script; `eslint --no-inline-config` over the five changed `.ts`/`.mjs` files exits 0.
</details>
